message: 数
On my way to the hilltop plaza for a change of pace――

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「63... 64... 65... Uhh, hmm~ Is this how it went, I wonder...?」
I run into Ria-senpai on the path leading up to Finis Tower, though she doesn't seem to have noticed me.
The bustle of the harbor echoes faintly from the distant pier, while the sports clubs are out running along the far side of the road.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaah!? Big Sis, please spare me already!」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Oh my, Synn-kun? How long have you been standing there?」

name: Synn
message: 「I literally just got here.」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-What is up with that reaction, Ria-chan... What have you been doing with Helena? Don't tell me you're doing all sorts of naughty things together even though you're real sisters?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Big Sis and I don't have the kind of relationship you're thinking of, Paa-chan. Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kuhhaa~, Ria-chan is cute even when she's pouting!」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come up to the hill to get some fresh air too, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, I came here after listening to Sally-chan's story. I wanted to brace myself... Sounds like you had the same idea, Synn-kun.」

name: Ria
message: 「Though the sports clubs are running and kicking up a lot of dust right now, so I think it's better if we wait a little while\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, let's do that.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai? What have you been doing this whole time?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I'm looking up at Finis Tower.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's such a mysterious tower... Even though it's an everyday sight to us, people visiting from other towns are always blown away by it.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a really old building, isn't it? I heard it's been standing here since before Ryuusei Academy was founded.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. They say it might even be older than the history of Ryuusei Town itself.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so that's why I ended up with no sense of direction.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as you're in Ryuusei Town, you can see Finis Tower from anywhere. So even if I'm walking through an unfamiliar block, there's no way I'll get lost.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once, I did an experiment to see how far I could go to run errands, and I ended up running for about half a day.」

name: Synn
message: 「When I did, I went all the way to a town where you couldn't see Finis Tower... and I got completely lost in no time.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Well, yeah. I'm sure I'd get lost too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, there's one more thing that seems obvious, yet isn't obvious at all, you know? Have you noticed?」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean how the key to long-distance running is your breathing technique and keeping your hips at a consistent height?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? U-Umm...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Read the room, Lord Synn. She's obviously talking about the mysteries of Finis Tower.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're talking rumors... There's that evil spirits are imprisoned in the tower, or that it's a gateway to another dimension, or an endlessly looping labyrinth, or that once you go inside you can never come back--」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu~. The Kujou family has managed that tower for generations, you know? It's not creepy like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's off-limits, I think people's imaginations just run wild.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! What is the strange phenomenon you can tell just by looking at the tower from the outside, even without going inside?」

name: Ria
message: 「Tick-tock, tick-tock... Bzzzt! Time's up!\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, please wait just a little longer!」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I shan't wait!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I want to try counting it together with you, Synn. How many stories tall Finis Tower is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Wh... Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't know how many floors the tower has. Nobody around me can give a clear answer either.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nobody around me knows either. Doesn't it seem like no one knows?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it! Then let's count them ourselves.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Here we go~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I lost track partway through...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, interesting.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ain't in the visible spectrum, but the design on that tower's walls is structured in a set pattern, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp... A-And?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just felt like saying it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Geez, don't get my hopes up like that, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「My bad, my bad.」

name: Ria
message: 「L-Let's try counting one more time, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」
...Ria-senpai and I gave it another shot, but in the end, we still couldn't tell for sure how many floors Finis Tower had.
